nodes.label: src/lib/pearcore.js single import surface
nodes.rationale: The only PearDrive file naming a pearcore path; deep imports because the package main points at a non-existent file.

nodes.label: PearDrive Catalog (persistent twin of spaceFileList)
nodes.rationale: Adds persistence, offline providers, per-provider deleted state, owner purges, tombstones, device roster, revision ring and a content-identity index that pearcore's in-memory per-session SpaceFileListManager lacks.

nodes.label: scripts/patch-pearcore.mjs (install-time patch set)
nodes.rationale: 868-line postinstall patching the installed pearcore copy: §1 merkleTree case, §D file-list replay, §D2 boot rebroadcast, §I offline rows, §J non-blocking join, §K peerFilter, §N remove emptiness, §P pino error, §Q hash-once, §V sodium verify, §W inert watcher.

nodes.label: PearDrive 0x03 control lane + STREAM data plane
nodes.rationale: Exists because only the JSON lane throttles; 256 KiB leaf unit, 8 leaves per chunkReq, MAX_PEER_INFLIGHT=4 because the shared socket has no backpressure; PearDrive overwrites pearcore's STREAM handler.

nodes.label: Priority tiers (INTERACTIVE / SELECTED / BACKGROUND) and viewer epochs
nodes.rationale: A starved interactive job owns the pipe exclusively until buffered; displacement by epoch is coolDown, never teardown.

nodes.label: Index quarantine / hash-once (prepare → commit)
nodes.rationale: Merkle trees are precomputed before the user commits and handed to localFileRegistry.add as {tree, metaHash}; new registry.add() dropped them, so §Q2 is a mandatory re-target or every file hashes twice.

nodes.label: Dedupe by hash (content-identity view, reclaim, cross-space reconnect)
nodes.rationale: Nothing stored or synced for the view; reclaim never touches the only local copy; cross-space reconnect registers content at the existing disk path with the tree read back from file_index.

nodes.label: Agent Mesh (src/engine/agent.js, AgentOps space)
nodes.rationale: A diagnostics mesh with no wire protocol: .pearmeta/agents/<host>/ mailboxes synced as ordinary files; heartbeat is derived state so same state yields same hash and silence; fixed read-only probe menu; cryptographic auth via signJSON against an admin set because provider attribution was bypassable.

nodes.label: StorageManager deleted upstream (29 call sites)
nodes.rationale: The single biggest break; replaced by free functions taking db, which as a bonus keep row ids.

nodes.label: Phase 1 plan (swap the storage layer, absorb ~15 upstream bugs)
nodes.rationale: Kimi's reframing: catalog, gossip, agent mesh, swarm manager and thumbnails have no pearcore equivalent and stay; fix §1, §I, §D/§D2, §Q2 in pearcore first, then an adapter in PearDrive for the StorageManager surface.
